mechanism_family_review.reason: Campaign044 used fixed equal weights and all-finite common support. Campaign102 learns bounded positive weights from contained training labels and uses broader fixed support.

Campaign101 remains one terminal source inside the exact complete v58 library. Campaign102 is a separately preregistered supervised model family already deferred before Campaign101 values; it does not alter Campaign101's formula, result, or direction.
Every coefficient is strictly positive and every input is oriented by its frozen v58 direction.
Every coefficient is at least 25 percent of uniform weight, so all 130 definitions remain materially active.
No component can exceed four times uniform weight. Each fitted validation-year score must still pass all 130 pairwise daily rank-correlation gates before that validation year's returns are read.
Exactly three lambda values, one target, one optimizer, one initialization, one support rule, one bounds box, and one fold sequence are permitted. Every outcome is appended.

algebraic_and_counterfactual_checks_befo: All admissible weights sum to one, are strictly positive, and preserve component directions.
Holding X fixed, changing a training target can change a fitted weight; changing a validation return cannot change a precomputed validation score or its uniqueness audit.
No one component can contribute more than 4/130 of an all-one score or less than 0.25/130 of an all-one score.
The feasible uniform vector exists, so the constrained optimization problem is never infeasible because of the bounds.
For lambda zero the bounded empirical loss is still a frozen catalog item; for positive lambda the penalty shrinks toward, but cannot replace, uniform weights.
Changing Candidate49, a semantic-only definition, a provider token, or current market state cannot change the frozen historical design.

finite_design_choices_frozen_before_valu.session_weighting: each training signal session has equal total loss weight
